integrity: Analytic killed-diffusion boundary-value argument and renewal proof; executable independent bridge-corrected trajectory simulation; external independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional driftless Brownian search with target \(L>0\), Poisson monitoring \(r>0\), instantaneous resets from \(x<0\) only, linear distance cost; no nonlinear cost, delayed returns, drift or passage-time joint law. The positive-rate mean fails to extend to \(r=0\).
title: Exact reset-count and accumulated-distance law for one-sided Brownian smart resetting
